--  TP BAT
-- ==================================================================
-- -- TP BAT (enhanced) ------------------------------------------
-- Pre-declare externally-referenced functions (used in UI toggle handlers and line 3641)
local startTpBat, stopTpBat
do  -- scope tpBat internals + CharacterAdded wiring to free 10 chunk registers
local _tpBat_h, _tpBat_hrp = nil, nil
local _TP_RANGE   = 3.5   -- TP whenever farther than this (studs)
local _TP_LEAD    = 0.08  -- velocity lookahead seconds for prediction

local function _tpBatGetBat()
    local char=LP.Character; if not char then return nil end
    local tool=char:FindFirstChild("Bat"); if tool then return tool end
    local bp2=LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if bp2 then tool=bp2:FindFirstChild("Bat"); if tool then tool.Parent=char; return tool end end
    return nil
end

local function _tpBatTryHit()
    if tpBatHittingCooldown then return end; tpBatHittingCooldown=true
    pcall(function()
        local bat=_tpBatGetBat(); if bat then
            bat:Activate()
            local ev=bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
            if ev then
                ev:FireServer()          -- first fire
                ev:FireServer()          -- double-tap in same window
            end
        end
    end)
    -- randomised cooldown: 60-110 ms so the pattern is harder to detect
    task.delay(0.06 + math.random()*0.05, function() tpBatHittingCooldown=false end)
end

local function _tpBatGetClosest()
    if not _tpBat_hrp then return nil,math.huge end
    local cp,cd=nil,math.huge
    for _,p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Character then
            local hum=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local tr =p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            -- skip dead/ragdolled targets
            if tr and hum and hum.Health>0 then
                local d=(_tpBat_hrp.Position-tr.Position).Magnitude
                if d<cd then cd=d; cp=p end
            end
        end
    end
    return cp,cd
end

-- Keep this helper on the shared state table instead of allocating another
-- chunk-level local register.  Luau's 200-register chunk limit can be reached
-- by this script's large feature set even though the helper itself is tiny.
_AK._tpBatSetupChar = function(char)
    task.wait(0.1)
    _tpBat_h=char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5); _tpBat_hrp=char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",5)
end

rawConn(RunService.Heartbeat, function()
    if not (tpBatEnabled and _tpBat_h and _tpBat_hrp) then return end
    local target,_ = _tpBatGetClosest()
    if not (target and target.Character) then return end
    local tr=target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not tr then return end

    -- velocity prediction: lead the target by _TP_LEAD seconds
    local vel    = tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local future = tr.Position + Vector3.new(vel.X*_TP_LEAD, 0, vel.Z*_TP_LEAD)
    local aimPos = future + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)  -- chest height

    -- teleport only when outside the engagement range
    if (_tpBat_hrp.Position - aimPos).Magnitude > _TP_RANGE then
        -- face the target while landing so swing arc is correct
        local lookDir = (tr.Position - aimPos)
        local facing  = lookDir.Magnitude > 0.01
                        and CFrame.lookAt(aimPos, tr.Position)
                        or  CFrame.new(aimPos)
        _tpBat_hrp.CFrame = facing
    end

    -- anchor physics desync
    pcall(function()
        if sethiddenproperty then sethiddenproperty(_tpBat_hrp,"PhysicsRepRootPart",tr) end
    end)

    -- keep camera locked on target
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    cam.CFrame=CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position,tr.Position)

    _tpBatTryHit()
end)

startTpBat = function()
    local char=LP.Character; if char then _AK._tpBatSetupChar(char) end
    setupAntiDie()
    monitorAntiDieHealth()
end
stopTpBat = function() tpBatEnabled=false; stopAntiDie() end

-- -- Speed Billboard (Green Duels V2 style) ---------------------
-- Store this helper on the existing shared table instead of creating
-- another chunk-level local. This preserves the feature while avoiding
-- Luau's 200-local-register limit in this large script.
_AK.setupSpeedIndicator = function(char)
    task.wait(0.1)
    local head=char:WaitForChild("Head",5); if not head then return end
    local oldBB=head:FindFirstChild("GreenDuelsBB"); if oldBB then oldBB:Destroy() end
    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui",head)
    bb.Name="GreenDuelsBB"
    bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,180,0,52)
    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.2,0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
    local nameLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel",bb)
    nameLbl.Name="NameBillLbl"
    nameLbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)
    nameLbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
    nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    nameLbl.Text="discord.gg/edge.vs"
    nameLbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    nameLbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    nameLbl.TextSize=13
    nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency=0.1
    nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
    nameLbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local line=Instance.new("Frame",bb)
    line.Name="SpeedNameDivider"
    line.Size=UDim2.new(0.72,0,0,1)

    line.BackgroundTransparency=0.25
    line.BorderSizePixel=0
    line.ZIndex=2

-- ==================================================================
--  OPPONENT SPEED BILLBOARDS
-- ==================================================================
_AK._setupOtherPlayerSpeed = function(player)
    local function onCharAdded(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        local hrp  = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not head or not hrp then return end
        local oldBB = head:FindFirstChild("GreenDuelsBB_Other")
        if oldBB then oldBB:Destroy() end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "GreenDuelsBB_Other"
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 24)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        local sl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        sl.Name = "SpeedBillLbl"
        sl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        sl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        sl.Text = "0.0"
        sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        sl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        sl.TextScaled = true
        sl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        sl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        task.spawn(function()
            while char and char.Parent and hrp and hrp.Parent and sl and sl.Parent do
                pcall(function()
                    sl.Text = string.format("%.1f", Vector3.new(hrp.Velocity.X, 0, hrp.Velocity.Z).Magnitude)
                end)
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end
    if player.Character then task.spawn(function() onCharAdded(player.Character) end) end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharAdded)
end

-- Keep the initial-player iteration in a nested function so its iterator
-- registers are isolated from the main chunk's 200-register budget.
_AK._setupExistingPlayerSpeeds = function(players)
    for _, p in ipairs(players) do
        if p ~= LP then task.spawn(function() _AK._setupOtherPlayerSpeed(p) end) end
    end
end
_AK._setupExistingPlayerSpeeds(Players:GetPlayers())
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    if p ~= LP then task.spawn(function() _AK._setupOtherPlayerSpeed(p) end) end
end)

-- CharacterAdded wiring
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    -- Reset steal state so auto steal / instant steal work again after death
    isStealing = false; stealStartTime = nil
    Steal.cachedPrompts = {}; Steal.promptCacheTime = 0; Steal.lastStealTick = 0; Steal.Data = {}
    StealV2.activeGrab = nil
    if _AK._SS2 then _AK._SS2.active = false; _AK._SS2.phase = "idle" end
    task.wait(0.5)
    _AK.setupSpeedIndicator(char)
    _AK._tpBatSetupChar(char)
    if tpBatEnabled then setupAntiDie(); task.wait(0.1); monitorAntiDieHealth() end
    if medusaCounterEnabled then setupMedusa(char) end
    if batCounterEnabled then startBatCounter() end
    if unwalkEnabled then startUnwalk() end
end)

-- Hook current character if already in game
if LP.Character then
    _AK.setupSpeedIndicator(LP.Character)
    task.spawn(function() _AK._tpBatSetupChar(LP.Character) end)
end

end  -- tpBat+CharacterAdded do-block: frees _tpBat_h/hrp, _TP_RANGE/LEAD, _tpBatGetBat/TryHit/GetClosest/SetupChar

    -- -- Anti Summer Base (remove blocking Anchor parts only — never wipe bases) --------
    local _asbConn = nil
    local _asbCleaned = {}
    local function _asbIsSummerName(name)
        if not name then return false end
        local n = tostring(name):lower()
        return n=="summerbase" or n=="summer_base" or n:find("summerbase",1,true)~=nil or n:find("summer_base",1,true)~=nil
    end
    local function _asbIsAnchorName(name)
        if not name then return false end
        local n = tostring(name):lower()
        return n=="anchor" or n=="anchors"
    end
    local function _asbStrip(obj)
        if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
        local key = tostring(obj:GetFullName())
        if _asbCleaned[key] then return end
        _asbCleaned[key] = true
        pcall(function()
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
                obj.CanCollide=false; obj.CanQuery=false; obj.CanTouch=false; obj.Transparency=1
            end
            obj:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    local function _asbRun()
        if not _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled then return end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _,plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local isSummer = _asbIsSummerName(plot.Name)
            if not isSummer then
                for _,d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                    if _asbIsSummerName(d.Name) then isSummer=true; break end
                end
            end
            if not isSummer then continue end
            for _,d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                if _asbIsAnchorName(d.Name) then _asbStrip(d) end
            end
        end
    end
    function _AK.enableAntiSummerBase()
        _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled = true
        _asbCleaned = {}
        _asbRun()
        if _asbConn then _asbConn:Disconnect(); _asbConn=nil end
        _asbConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled then return end
            if not _asbIsAnchorName(obj.Name) then return end
            task.defer(function()
                if not _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled or not obj.Parent then return end
                local p = obj
                local underPlots, nearSummer = false, false
                while p and p ~= workspace do
                    if p.Name=="Plots" or (p.Parent and p.Parent.Name=="Plots") then underPlots=true end
                    if _asbIsSummerName(p.Name) then nearSummer=true end
                    p = p.Parent
                end
                if underPlots and nearSummer then _asbStrip(obj) end
            end)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled do
                _asbRun()
                task.wait(5)
            end
        end)
    end
    function _AK.disableAntiSummerBase()
        _Flags.antiSummerBaseEnabled = false
        if _asbConn then _asbConn:Disconnect(); _asbConn=nil end
    end
    -- -- Charter Feature: Headless ------------------------------------------
    local function _charterRemoveFace(head)
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then pcall(function() face:Destroy() end) end
    end
    local function _charterApplyHeadless(char)
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        pcall(function()
            head.Transparency = 1
            head.CanCollide = false
            _charterRemoveFace(head)
            for _, child in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and child.MeshId == "rbxassetid://1095708" then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://1095708"
            mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
            mesh.Name = "HeadlessMesh"
            mesh.Parent = head
        end)
    end
    local function _charterRestoreHeadless(char)
        if not char then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        pcall(function()
            head.Transparency = 0
            head.CanCollide = true
            for _, child in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and child.Name == "HeadlessMesh" then
                    pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            _charterRemoveFace(head)
        end)
    end
    local _headlessConn = nil
    function _AK.enableHeadless()
        _Flags.headlessEnabled = true
        _charterApplyHeadless(LP.Character)
    end
    function _AK.disableHeadless()
        _Flags.headlessEnabled = false
        _charterRestoreHeadless(LP.Character)
    end
    -- Headless auto re-applies on respawn
    if _headlessConn then _headlessConn:Disconnect() end
    _headlessConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(1)
        if _Flags.headlessEnabled then _charterApplyHeadless(char) end
    end)
    if LP.Character then task.spawn(function() task.wait(1); _charterApplyHeadless(LP.Character) end) end
end)()  -- end settings-functions IIFE
-- Edge-style ScreenGui Box ESP
do
    local boxEnabled, lineEnabled = false, false
    local boxGui, lineGui = nil, nil
    local boxData, lineData = {}, {}
    local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
    local boxConn, lineConn = nil, nil

    local function destroyBox()
        if boxConn then pcall(function() boxConn:Disconnect() end); boxConn = nil end
        if boxGui then pcall(function() boxGui:Destroy() end); boxGui = nil end
        boxData = {}
    end
    local function ensureBoxGui()
        if boxGui and boxGui.Parent then return boxGui end
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "AKAI_BoxESP"
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.DisplayOrder = 10000
        pcall(function() g.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if not g.Parent then g.Parent = PGui end
        boxGui = g
        return g
    end

    local function ensureLineGui()
        if lineGui and lineGui.Parent then return lineGui end
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "AKAI_LineESP"
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.DisplayOrder = 9999
        g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
        pcall(function() g.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if not g.Parent then g.Parent = PGui end
        lineGui = g
        return g
    end

    local function destroyLine()
        if lineConn then pcall(function() lineConn:Disconnect() end); lineConn = nil end
        if lineGui then pcall(function() lineGui:Destroy() end); lineGui = nil end
        lineData = {}
    end
    local function getBox(uid)
        local d = boxData[uid]
        if d and d.holder and d.holder.Parent then return d end
        local gui = ensureBoxGui()
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name = "Box_" .. tostring(uid)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
        holder.Visible = false
        holder.Parent = gui
        local function mk()
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.BorderSizePixel = 0
            f.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
            f.Parent = holder
            return f
        end
        d = { holder = holder, top = mk(), bottom = mk(), left = mk(), right = mk() }
        boxData[uid] = d
        return d
    end

    local function showBox(uid, x, y, w, h)
        local d = getBox(uid)
        if not d then return end
        local T = 2
        d.holder.Visible = true
        d.holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
        d.holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
        d.top.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, T); d.top.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        d.bottom.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, T); d.bottom.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -T)
        d.left.Size = UDim2.new(0, T, 1, 0); d.left.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        d.right.Size = UDim2.new(0, T, 1, 0); d.right.Position = UDim2.new(1, -T, 0, 0)
    end

    local function hideBox(uid)
        local d = boxData[uid]
        if d and d.holder then d.holder.Visible = false end
    end

    local function worldToScreenLocked(worldPos, cam)
        local vp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
        local vw, vh = cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y
        local x, y, z = vp.X, vp.Y, vp.Z
        if z <= 0 then
            x = vw * 0.5 - (x - vw * 0.5)
            y = vh * 0.5 - (y - vh * 0.5)
        end
        local margin = 3
        return Vector2.new(math.clamp(x, margin, vw - margin), math.clamp(y, margin, vh - margin))
    end


    local function getLine(uid)
        local d = lineData[uid]
        if d and d.frame and d.frame.Parent then return d end
        local gui = ensureLineGui()
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = "Line_" .. tostring(uid)
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        f.Visible = false
        f.ZIndex = 50
        f.Parent = gui
        d = {frame = f}
        lineData[uid] = d
        return d
    end

    local function updateScreenLine(frame, from, to, color)
        local dx, dy = to.X - from.X, to.Y - from.Y
        local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if dist < 1 then frame.Visible = false; return end
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(dist, 2)
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((from.X + to.X) * 0.5, (from.Y + to.Y) * 0.5)
        frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = color or ACCENT
        frame.Visible = true
    end

    local function updateLines()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local vw, vh = cam.ViewportSize.X, cam.ViewportSize.Y
        local from = Vector2.new(vw * 0.5, vh - 2)
        local alive = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local uid = plr.UserId
                alive[uid] = true
                local char = plr.Character
                local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local d = getLine(uid)
                if not root or (hum and hum.Health <= 0) then
                    if d then d.frame.Visible = false end
                else
                    local tp, visible = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                    local toX, toY = tp.X, tp.Y
                    if tp.Z <= 0 then
                        toX = vw * 0.5 + (vw * 0.5 - toX)
                        toY = vh * 0.5 + (vh * 0.5 - toY)
                    end
                    toX = math.clamp(toX, 2, vw - 2)
                    toY = math.clamp(toY, 2, vh - 2)
                    updateScreenLine(d.frame, from, Vector2.new(toX, toY), ACCENT)
                end
            end
        end
        for uid in pairs(lineData) do
            if not alive[uid] then
                local d = lineData[uid]
                if d and d.frame then pcall(function() d.frame:Destroy() end) end
                lineData[uid] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    local function updateBoxes()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        local alive = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local uid = plr.UserId
                alive[uid] = true
                local char = plr.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not root or not head or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                    hideBox(uid)
                else
                    local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                    local headPos = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0))
                    if onScreen and pos.Z > 0 then
                        local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - pos.Y) * 2.25
                        if height < 28 then height = 72 end
                        local width = height / 2.05
                        showBox(uid, pos.X - width / 2, pos.Y - height / 2, width, height)
                    else
                        hideBox(uid)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for uid in pairs(boxData) do
            if not alive[uid] then
                local d = boxData[uid]
                if d and d.holder then pcall(function() d.holder:Destroy() end) end
                boxData[uid] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    _AK.setBoxESP = function(on)
        boxEnabled = on == true
        if boxEnabled then
            ensureBoxGui()
            if not boxConn then boxConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateBoxes) end
        else
            destroyBox()
        end
    end
    _AK.setLineESP = function(on)
        lineEnabled = on == true
        if lineEnabled then
            ensureLineGui()
            if not lineConn then lineConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateLines) end
        else
            destroyLine()
        end
    end
end

;(function()
    local _SC = {} -- sky color module
    local _scConn = nil
    local _scSky  = nil
    local _scFX   = {}   -- lighting effect instances created by a preset

    -- Save original lighting settings once (shared with _BS system)
    local function _scSaveOrig()
        if _BS.origSettings.FogColor then return end -- already saved by _BS
        _BS.origSettings.FogColor             = Lighting.FogColor
        _BS.origSettings.FogEnd               = Lighting.FogEnd
        _BS.origSettings.FogStart             = Lighting.FogStart
        _BS.origSettings.Brightness           = Lighting.Brightness
        _BS.origSettings.ClockTime            = Lighting.ClockTime
        _BS.origSettings.ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation
        _BS.origSettings.OutdoorAmbient       = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        _BS.origSettings.Ambient              = Lighting.Ambient
        for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Sky") then _BS.origSky=obj:Clone(); break end
        end
    end

    local function _scDestroyFX()
        for _,fx in ipairs(_scFX) do pcall(function() fx:Destroy() end) end
        _scFX = {}
    end
    local function _scKillSky()
        if _scSky then _scSky:Destroy(); _scSky=nil end
        for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Sky") then obj:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    local function _scMakeSky(bk,dn,ft,lf,rt,up,stars)
        _scKillSky()
        _scSky = Instance.new("Sky")
        _scSky.Name      = "AKSkyColor"
        _scSky.SkyboxBk  = bk; _scSky.SkyboxDn = dn; _scSky.SkyboxFt = ft
        _scSky.SkyboxLf  = lf; _scSky.SkyboxRt = rt; _scSky.SkyboxUp = up
        _scSky.StarCount = stars or 0
        _scSky.Parent    = Lighting
    end
    local function _scAddCC(sat,tint,bright,contrast)
        local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        cc.Name = "AKSkyCC"; cc.Saturation=sat; cc.TintColor=tint
        cc.Brightness=bright; cc.Contrast=contrast; cc.Parent=Lighting
        table.insert(_scFX, cc); return cc
    end
    local function _scAddBloom(int,sz,thr)
        local b = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        b.Name="AKSkyBloom"; b.Intensity=int; b.Size=sz; b.Threshold=thr; b.Parent=Lighting
        table.insert(_scFX, b); return b
    end
    local function _scAddAtmo(col,density,offset,decay)
        local a = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
        a.Name="AKSkyAtmo"; a.Color=col; a.Density=density; a.Offset=offset; a.Decay=decay; a.Parent=Lighting
        table.insert(_scFX, a); return a
    end
    local function _scAddSun(int,spread)
        local s = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
        s.Name="AKSkySun"; s.Intensity=int; s.Spread=spread; s.Parent=Lighting
        table.insert(_scFX, s); return s
    end

    -- -- Preset definitions ----------------------------------------
    local SKY_PRESETS = {
        -- 1: PURPLE  (original Beautiful Sky, starry night)
        function()
            _scMakeSky("rbxassetid://48020371","rbxassetid://48020144","rbxassetid://48020234",
                       "rbxassetid://48020211","rbxassetid://48020254","rbxassetid://48020383",3000)
            Lighting.Brightness=5.5; Lighting.ClockTime=17; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=0.3
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(80,75,90); Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(70,67,78)
            Lighting.FogColor=Color3.fromRGB(155,130,185); Lighting.FogEnd=220; Lighting.FogStart=35
            _scAddCC(0.55,Color3.fromRGB(180,160,200),0.18,0.08)
            _scAddBloom(1.8,56,0.5)
            _scAddAtmo(Color3.fromRGB(180,120,150),0.15,0.1,Color3.fromRGB(200,150,180))
            _scAddSun(0.25,0.5)
        end,
        -- 2: BLUE  (clear daytime cyan-blue sky)
        function()
            Lighting.Brightness=2; Lighting.ClockTime=14; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=0
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(120,155,200); Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(100,140,190)
            Lighting.FogColor=Color3.fromRGB(180,215,255); Lighting.FogEnd=1e10; Lighting.FogStart=0
            _scAddCC(0.4,Color3.fromRGB(160,200,255),0.08,0.05)
            _scAddBloom(0.8,32,0.6)
            _scAddAtmo(Color3.fromRGB(110,185,255),0.18,0.06,Color3.fromRGB(90,160,255))
            _scAddSun(0.4,0.55)
        end,
        -- 3: SUNSET  (warm orange-pink horizon)
        function()
            Lighting.Brightness=3; Lighting.ClockTime=19; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=0.15
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(210,130,80); Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(190,110,60)
            Lighting.FogColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,160,100); Lighting.FogEnd=280; Lighting.FogStart=40
            _scAddCC(0.6,Color3.fromRGB(255,180,120),0.22,0.1)
            _scAddBloom(2.2,64,0.45)
            _scAddAtmo(Color3.fromRGB(255,140,80),0.22,0.12,Color3.fromRGB(255,100,60))
            _scAddSun(0.6,0.65)
        end,
        -- 4: NIGHT  (dark deep-blue night sky, many stars)
        function()
            _scMakeSky("rbxassetid://48020371","rbxassetid://48020144","rbxassetid://48020234",
                       "rbxassetid://48020211","rbxassetid://48020254","rbxassetid://48020383",6000)
            Lighting.Brightness=0.3; Lighting.ClockTime=0; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=-0.2
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(20,22,45); Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(15,17,35)
            Lighting.FogColor=Color3.fromRGB(10,12,30); Lighting.FogEnd=300; Lighting.FogStart=80
            _scAddCC(0.3,Color3.fromRGB(100,110,180),-0.05,0.15)
            _scAddBloom(1.2,48,0.4)
            _scAddAtmo(Color3.fromRGB(40,50,120),0.1,0.05,Color3.fromRGB(20,25,80))
        end,
        -- 5: GOLDEN  (golden hour, warm amber glow)
        function()
            Lighting.Brightness=4; Lighting.ClockTime=18; Lighting.ExposureCompensation=0.25
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(230,180,80); Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(210,160,60)
            Lighting.FogColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,210,120); Lighting.FogEnd=350; Lighting.FogStart=50
            _scAddCC(0.7,Color3.fromRGB(255,220,140),0.28,0.08)
            _scAddBloom(2.5,72,0.4)
            _scAddAtmo(Color3.fromRGB(255,200,80),0.2,0.15,Color3.fromRGB(255,160,40))
            _scAddSun(0.7,0.7)
        end,
    }

    local SKY_NAMES = {"OFF","PURPLE","BLUE","SUNSET","NIGHT","GOLDEN"}

    local function _scRestoreOrig()
        if _BS.origSettings.FogColor then
            Lighting.FogColor             = _BS.origSettings.FogColor
            Lighting.FogEnd               = _BS.origSettings.FogEnd
            Lighting.FogStart             = _BS.origSettings.FogStart
            Lighting.Brightness           = _BS.origSettings.Brightness
            Lighting.ClockTime            = _BS.origSettings.ClockTime
            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = _BS.origSettings.ExposureCompensation
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient       = _BS.origSettings.OutdoorAmbient
            Lighting.Ambient              = _BS.origSettings.Ambient
        end
        if _BS.origSky then
            _scKillSky()
            _BS.origSky:Clone().Parent = Lighting
        end
    end

    -- stop any running override connection + destroy effects
    local function _scStop()
        if _scConn then _scConn:Disconnect(); _scConn=nil end
        _scDestroyFX(); _scKillSky()
    end

    -- apply preset idx (1-based). 0 = off.
    local function _scApply(idx)
        _scStop()
        if idx == 0 then _scRestoreOrig(); return end
        _scSaveOrig()
        -- also disable _BS override if it's running
        if _BS.enabled then _BS.enabled=false; disableBeautifulSky() end
        _scDestroyFX(); _scKillSky()
        local fn = SKY_PRESETS[idx]
        if fn then pcall(fn) end
        -- keep re-applying each RenderStep so game can't revert it
        _scConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if _BS.colorIdx == 0 then _scStop(); return end
            -- guard sky
            for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Sky") and obj ~= _scSky then obj:Destroy() end
            end
            if _scSky and not _scSky.Parent then _scSky.Parent = Lighting end
        end)
    end

    -- exposed function called by UI navigator
    _SC.apply = _scApply
    _SC.names = SKY_NAMES
    _AK._skyColor = _SC
end)()  -- end sky color IIFE

            local isV1 = (dropMode == "v1")
            v1Chip.BackgroundColor3 = isV1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(40,40,44)
            v1Chip.TextColor3       = isV1 and Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)       or Color3.fromRGB(140,140,140)
            v2Chip.BackgroundColor3 = (not isV1) and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) or Color3.fromRGB(40,40,44)
            v2Chip.TextColor3       = (not isV1) and Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)       or Color3.fromRGB(140,140,140)
        end
        refreshDropMode()
        _AK._refreshDropModeChips = refreshDropMode

        v1Chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            dropMode = "v1"; _configState["dropMode"] = "v1"; _autoSaveConfig(); refreshDropMode()
        end)
        v2Chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            dropMode = "v2"; _configState["dropMode"] = "v2"; _autoSaveConfig(); refreshDropMode()
        end)

        hoverRow(Row, ROW_ALPHA)
    end
end)()

-- -- Shared helpers (1 local instead of 5, keeps chunk under Lua's 200-local limit)
_AK.B64      = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
_AK.setFontUI = nil -- set in Settings > Font block
function _AK.encode(s)
    local r, pad = {}, ""
    local n = #s % 3
    if n > 0 then s = s .. string.rep("\0", 3 - n); pad = string.rep("=", 3 - n) end
    for i = 1, #s, 3 do
        local a, b, c = string.byte(s, i, i + 2)
        local v = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 16), bit32.lshift(b, 8), c)
        r[#r+1] = _AK.B64:sub(bit32.rshift(v, 18) + 1, bit32.rshift(v, 18) + 1)
        r[#r+1] = _AK.B64:sub(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 12), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 12), 63) + 1)
        r[#r+1] = _AK.B64:sub(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v,  6), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v,  6), 63) + 1)
        r[#r+1] = _AK.B64:sub(bit32.band(v, 63) + 1, bit32.band(v, 63) + 1)
    end
    local out = table.concat(r)
    return out:sub(1, #out - #pad) .. pad
end
function _AK.decode(s)
    local t = {}
    for i = 1, #_AK.B64 do t[_AK.B64:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
    s = s:gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9+/=]", "")
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, #s, 4 do
        local a = t[s:sub(i,   i  )] or 0
        local b = t[s:sub(i+1, i+1)] or 0
        local c = t[s:sub(i+2, i+2)] or 0
        local d = t[s:sub(i+3, i+3)] or 0
        local v = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 18), bit32.lshift(b, 12), bit32.lshift(c, 6), d)
        r[#r+1] = string.char(bit32.rshift(v, 16))
        if s:sub(i+2, i+2) ~= "=" then r[#r+1] = string.char(bit32.band(bit32.rshift(v, 8), 0xFF)) end
        if s:sub(i+3, i+3) ~= "=" then r[#r+1] = string.char(bit32.band(v, 0xFF)) end
    end
    return table.concat(r)
end

-- Config key compression: long key names → 2-char codes (saves ~60% on export)
_AK.cfgPack = {
    bgIndex="a0",fontIdx="a1",menuW="a2",menuH="a3",
    menuXScale="a4",menuXOffset="a5",menuYScale="a6",menuYOffset="a7",
    normalSpeed="a8",carrySpeed_val="a9",laggerSpeed="b0",laggerCarrySpeed="b1",
    tpHeight="b2",v1Radius="b3",v2StealRadius="b4",fbBtnSize="b5",
    infJumpMode="b6",hudBarXScale="b7",hudBarYScale="b8",hudBarXOffset="b9",
    hudBarYOffset="c0",skyColorIdx="c1",dragLocked="c2",
    AUTOLEFT="c3",AUTORIGHT="c4",AUTOTP="c5",AUTOCARRY="c6",
    AUTOSTEAL="c7",AUTOGRABV2="c8",CARRYBYPASS="d1",LAGMODE="d2",
    ANTILAG="d3",ANTIRAGDOLL="d4",INFJUMP="d5",DARKMODE="d6",
    FOV120="d7",STRETCHREZ="d8",BATCOUNTER="d9",MEDUSACOUNTER="e0",
    VAMPIREANM="e2",LAGMODE="d2",
}
_AK.cfgUpack = {}
for k,v in pairs(_AK.cfgPack) do _AK.cfgUpack[v]=k end
do  -- scope _cfgPK/_cfgUK: frees 2 chunk registers before the HUD section
local function _cfgPK(k)
    if _AK.cfgPack[k] then return _AK.cfgPack[k] end
    local s=k:match("^btnVis_(.+)$");if s then return "V"..s end
    s=k:match("^kb_(.+)$");if s then return "K"..s end
    s=k:match("^btnPos_(.+)$");if s then return "P"..s end
    return k
end
local function _cfgUK(k)
    if _AK.cfgUpack[k] then return _AK.cfgUpack[k] end
    local s=k:match("^V(.+)$");if s then return "btnVis_"..s end
    s=k:match("^K(.+)$");if s then return "kb_"..s end
    s=k:match("^P(.+)$");if s then return "btnPos_"..s end
    return k
end
_AK.packCfg=function(t) local r={};for k,v in pairs(t) do r[_cfgPK(k)]=v end;return r end
_AK.unpackCfg=function(t) local r={};for k,v in pairs(t) do r[_cfgUK(k)]=v end;return r end
end  -- _cfgPK and _cfgUK are freed here; upvalues still live inside _AK.packCfg/_AK.unpackCfg

        pubStatus.Position           = UDim2.new(0.55,0,0.5,-8)
        pubStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        pubStatus.Text               = ""
        pubStatus.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(130,220,130)
        pubStatus.TextSize           = 10
        pubStatus.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        pubStatus.TextXAlignment     = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        pubStatus.TextTruncate       = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        pubStatus.ZIndex             = 5

        local pubCodeLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", pubRow)
        pubCodeLbl.Size               = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,12)
        pubCodeLbl.Position           = UDim2.new(0,12,0,40)
        pubCodeLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        pubCodeLbl.Text               = ""
        pubCodeLbl.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(100,200,100)
        pubCodeLbl.TextSize           = 9
        pubCodeLbl.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold

        local pubBusy = false

        pubHit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

        pubHit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

            pubBusy = true
            pubStatus.Text       = "ENCODING..."

            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, code = pcall(function()

                    _configState["fontIdx"]  = _currentFontIdx

                    for k, v in pairs(_configState) do snapshot[k] = v end
                    snapshot.bgIndex = _bgIndex
                    snapshot.fontIdx = _currentFontIdx
                    return "AKAI-" .. _AK.encode(HS:JSONEncode(_AK.packCfg(snapshot)))

                if ok and code then

        impBox.BorderSizePixel    = 0

        impBtn.Size               = UDim2.new(0,60,0,24)
        impBtn.Position           = UDim2.new(1,-70,0,28)
        impBtn.BackgroundColor3   = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
        impBtn.BorderSizePixel    = 0
        impBtn.Text               = "IMPORT"
        impBtn.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
        impBtn.TextSize           = 11
        impBtn.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        impBtn.ZIndex             = 6
        addCorner(impBtn, 5)
        addStroke(impBtn, Color3.fromRGB(70,70,70), 1)

        local impStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel", impRow)
        impStatus.Size               = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,10)
        impStatus.Position           = UDim2.new(0,12,1,-11)
        impStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        impStatus.Text               = ""
        impStatus.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(220,80,80)
        impStatus.TextSize           = 9
        impStatus.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        impStatus.TextXAlignment     = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        impStatus.ZIndex             = 5

        local impBusy = false
        impBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if impBusy then return end
            local raw = impBox.Text:gsub("%s+", "")
            if raw == "" then
                impStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,80,80)
                impStatus.Text       = "ENTER A CODE FIRST."
                return
            end
            impBusy      = true
            impBtn.Text  = "..."
            impStatus.Text = ""
            local ok, saved = pcall(function()
                local encoded = raw:match("^[Aa][Kk][Aa][Ii]%-(.+)$") or raw
                return _AK.unpackCfg(HS:JSONDecode(_AK.decode(encoded)))
            end)
            if ok and type(saved) == "table" then
                for _, entry in ipairs(_toggleRegistry) do
                    local on = saved[entry.key]
                    if on ~= nil then
                        entry.setState(on)
                        _configState[entry.key] = on
                        if entry.callback then pcall(entry.callback, on) end
                    end
                end
                if saved.bgIndex ~= nil then
                    applyBg(saved.bgIndex)
                    _configState.bgIndex = saved.bgIndex
                    if _AK.setBgUI then _AK.setBgUI(saved.bgIndex) end
                end
                if saved.fontIdx ~= nil then
                    _currentFontIdx = math.max(1, math.min(#_FONTS, saved.fontIdx))
                    applyFontToGui()
                    _configState.fontIdx = _currentFontIdx
                    if _AK.setFontUI then _AK.setFontUI() end
                end
                if saved.infJumpMode then
                    local mode = saved.infJumpMode
                    if mode == "manual" or mode == "hold" then
                        infJumpMode = mode
                        if _AK.updateJumpModeUI then _AK.updateJumpModeUI(mode) end
                    end
                end
                _autoSaveConfig()
                impBox.Text          = ""
                impStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130,220,130)
                impStatus.Text       = "CONFIG APPLIED!"
                task.wait(3)
                impStatus.Text = ""
            else
                impStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,80,80)
                impStatus.Text       = "INVALID CONFIG CODE."
                task.wait(3)
                impStatus.Text = ""
            end
            impBtn.Text = "IMPORT"
            impBusy     = false
        end)
    end
end)()

-- -- Auto-load saved config on start ---------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
    -- Restore menu position immediately (before any wait) to avoid flash
    do
        local saved = loadConfig()
        if saved["menuXOffset"] and saved["menuYOffset"] then
            Container.Position = UDim2.new(
                saved["menuXScale"] or 0, saved["menuXOffset"],
                saved["menuYScale"] or 0, saved["menuYOffset"]
            )
        end
    end
    -- no artificial wait – registry is already populated
    if not isAlive() then return end
    local saved = loadConfig()
    if not next(saved) then
        -- First run: apply default font (DenkOne) even with no saved config
        applyFontToGui()
        return
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(_toggleRegistry) do
        local on = saved[entry.key]
        if on then
            entry.setState(true)
            _configState[entry.key] = true
            if entry.callback then pcall(entry.callback, true) end
        end
    end
    -- Restore drop mode
    if saved["dropMode"] then
        dropMode = saved["dropMode"]
        if _AK._refreshDropModeChips then _AK._refreshDropModeChips() end
    end
    -- Restore background
    if saved["bgIndex"] ~= nil then
        applyBg(saved["bgIndex"])
        _configState["bgIndex"] = saved["bgIndex"]
        if _AK.setBgUI then _AK.setBgUI(saved["bgIndex"]) end
    end
    -- Restore font
    if saved["fontIdx"] ~= nil then
        _currentFontIdx = math.max(1, math.min(#_FONTS, saved["fontIdx"]))
        applyFontToGui()
        _configState["fontIdx"] = saved["fontIdx"]
        if _AK.setFontUI then _AK.setFontUI() end
    end
    -- Restore Semi Steal Radius
    -- v2PrimeRadius is restored above from saved["v2PrimeRadius"]
    if false and saved["grabV2Radius"] ~= nil then
        AG_CONFIG.V2_PRIME_RANGE = math.max(1, saved["grabV2Radius"])
    end
    -- Restore menu size
    Container.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 360) -- fixed size
    if saved["dragLocked"] ~= nil then DragLocked = saved["dragLocked"] == true end

    -- Restore menu position
    if saved["menuXOffset"] and saved["menuYOffset"] then
        Container.Position = UDim2.new(
            saved["menuXScale"] or 0, saved["menuXOffset"],
            saved["menuYScale"] or 0, saved["menuYOffset"]
        )
    end
    -- Restore FB button size (deferred so FB buttons exist first)
    if saved["fbBtnSize"] and type(saved["fbBtnSize"]) == "number" then
        task.defer(function()
            if _AK._setFbSize then _AK._setFbSize(math.clamp(saved["fbBtnSize"], 35, 120)) end
        end)
    end
    -- Restore Jump Mode
    if saved["infJumpMode"] then
        local mode = saved["infJumpMode"]
        if mode == "manual" or mode == "hold" then
            infJumpMode = mode
            if _AK.updateJumpModeUI then _AK.updateJumpModeUI(mode) end
        end
    end
    -- Restore Speed values
    if saved["normalSpeed"]     then NS = saved["normalSpeed"];                     if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.ns(NS)   end end
    if saved["carrySpeed_val"]  then CS = saved["carrySpeed_val"];                  if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.cs(CS)   end end
    if saved["laggerSpeed"]     then LAGGER_SPEED = saved["laggerSpeed"];           if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.ls(LAGGER_SPEED) end end
    if saved["laggerCarrySpeed"] then LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED = saved["laggerCarrySpeed"]; if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.lcs(LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) end end
    -- Restore Mechanics values
    if saved["v1Radius"] then Steal.StealRadius=saved["v1Radius"]; if _AK._mechSetters and _AK._mechSetters.stealR then _AK._mechSetters.stealR(saved["v1Radius"]) end end
    -- V2_PRIME_RANGE is fixed at 61, not restored from config
    AG_CONFIG.V2_PRIME_RANGE = 61
    if saved["v2StealRadius"] then AG_CONFIG.V2_STEAL_RANGE=saved["v2StealRadius"]; if _AK._mechSetters and _AK._mechSetters.v2SR then _AK._mechSetters.v2SR(saved["v2StealRadius"]) end end
    if saved["tpHeight"]    then autoTPHeight = saved["tpHeight"];         if _AK._mechSetters then _AK._mechSetters.tph(saved["tpHeight"])    end end
    if saved["batSpeed"]    then AUTO_BAT.SPEED = saved["batSpeed"];       if _AK._batSetter   then _AK._batSetter(saved["batSpeed"])          end end
    if saved["batSpeedNormal"] then AUTO_BAT.SPEED_NORMAL = saved["batSpeedNormal"]; if _AK._batSpeedSetters then _AK._batSpeedSetters.normal(saved["batSpeedNormal"]) end end
    if saved["batSpeedBypass"] then AUTO_BAT.SPEED_BYPASS = saved["batSpeedBypass"]; if _AK._batSpeedSetters then _AK._batSpeedSetters.bypass(saved["batSpeedBypass"]) end end
    if saved["autoBatMode"] then autoBatMode = saved["autoBatMode"]; if _AK._refreshAimbotModeChips then _AK._refreshAimbotModeChips() end end
    -- Restore floating button positions (deferred so buttons are spawned first)
    task.defer(function()
        local btnKeys = {"speedKey","laggerKey","autoLeft","autoRight","drop",
                         "autoBat","tpBat","tpDown"}
        for _, bkey in ipairs(btnKeys) do
            local p = saved["btnPos_" .. bkey]
            if p and type(p) == "table" and p.xOff ~= nil and p.yOff ~= nil then
                local btn = _AK._fbBtns and _AK._fbBtns[bkey]
                if btn then
                    btn.Position = UDim2.new(
                        p.xScale or 0, p.xOff,
                        p.yScale or 0, p.yOff
                    )
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

-- ==================================================================
--  HUD BAR  (steal progress bar - draggable pill at bottom)
-- ==================================================================
-- DragLocked declared early
-- ── Show button drag (movable, position saved/restored with config) ─────────
do
    local _sdn, _sds, _ssp, _sdDragging = false, nil, nil, false
    ShowBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if DragLocked then return end
        _sdn = true; _sds = i.Position; _ssp = ShowBtn.Position; _sdDragging = false
    end)
    rawConn(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if not _sdn then return end
        _sdn = false
        if _sdDragging then
            _configState["showBtnPos"] = {
                xScale = ShowBtn.Position.X.Scale, xOff = ShowBtn.Position.X.Offset,
                yScale = ShowBtn.Position.Y.Scale, yOff = ShowBtn.Position.Y.Offset,
            }
            saveConfigNow(_configState)
        end
        _sdDragging = false
    end)
    ShowBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not _sdn then return end
        if DragLocked then _sdn = false; return end
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local d = i.Position - _sds
        if not _sdDragging then
            if math.abs(d.X) > 8 or math.abs(d.Y) > 8 then _sdDragging = true; _showBtnDragged = true else return end
        end
        local vp = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
        local rawX = _ssp.X.Scale * vp.X + _ssp.X.Offset + d.X
        local rawY = _ssp.Y.Scale * vp.Y + _ssp.Y.Offset + d.Y
        ShowBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(rawX, 0, vp.X - ShowBtn.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, math.clamp(rawY, 0, vp.Y - ShowBtn.AbsoluteSize.Y))
    end)
    -- Restore saved position from config
    local _sbp = _configState["showBtnPos"]
    if _sbp and type(_sbp) == "table" and _sbp.xOff ~= nil then
        ShowBtn.Position = UDim2.new(_sbp.xScale or 0, _sbp.xOff, _sbp.yScale or 0, _sbp.yOff)
    end
end

        if isStealing and stealStartTime then
            -- V1: straight duration, status mirrors percentage
            pct = math.clamp((tick() - stealStartTime) / Steal.StealDuration, 0, 1)
            status = "pct"
        elseif _AK._SS2 and _AK._SS2.active then
            -- V2: hold phase progresses 0 100% over HOLD_MAX; ready once past the 48% mark
            local elapsed = tick() - _AK._SS2.startTime
            pct = math.clamp(elapsed / AG_CONFIG.HOLD_MAX, 0, 1)
            status = (pct >= 0.48) and "ready" or "unready"
        end
        -- update fill bar + percentage (only when changed, avoids needless writes)
        if math.abs(pct - _lastPct) > 0.001 then
            _lastPct = pct
            if progressFill and progressFill.Parent then
                progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
            end
            if progressPct and progressPct.Parent then
                progressPct.Text = math.floor(pct * 100) .. "%"
            end
        end
        -- update status label (READY / UNREADY / percent / cleared)
        if status ~= _lastStatus or status == "pct" then
            _lastStatus = status
            if progressStatusLbl and progressStatusLbl.Parent then
                if status == "ready" then
                    progressStatusLbl.Text      = "READY"
                    progressStatusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 140)
                elseif status == "unready" then
                    progressStatusLbl.Text      = "UNREADY"
                    progressStatusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                elseif status == "pct" then
                    progressStatusLbl.Text      = math.floor(pct * 100) .. "%"
                    progressStatusLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205)
                else
                    progressStatusLbl.Text = ""
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Drag (respects DragLocked)
    do local hd, hs, hp = false, nil, nil
        Hud.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if DragLocked then return end
            if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                hd=true; hs=i.Position; hp=Hud.Position end end)
        Hud.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if not hd then return end
            if DragLocked then hd=false; return end
            if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local d=i.Position-hs
                Hud.Position=UDim2.new(hp.X.Scale,hp.X.Offset+d.X,hp.Y.Scale,hp.Y.Offset+d.Y) end end)
        rawConn(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
            if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if not hd then return end
            hd=false
            -- Save position when drag ends
            _configState["hudBarXScale"]  = Hud.Position.X.Scale
            _configState["hudBarXOffset"] = Hud.Position.X.Offset
            _configState["hudBarYScale"]  = Hud.Position.Y.Scale
            _configState["hudBarYOffset"] = Hud.Position.Y.Offset
            saveConfigNow(_configState)
        end)
    end

    -- Restore saved position
    task.defer(function()
        local saved = loadConfig()
        if saved["hudBarXOffset"] ~= nil and saved["hudBarYOffset"] ~= nil then
            Hud.Position = UDim2.new(
                saved["hudBarXScale"]  or 0.5, saved["hudBarXOffset"],
                saved["hudBarYScale"]  or 1,   saved["hudBarYOffset"]
            )
        end
    end)
end)()

-- ==================================================================
--  FLOATING BUTTONS (Storm style UI + Akai logic)
-- ==================================================================
;(function()
    local BTN_W, BTN_H, GAP = 64, 48, 14
    local COLS = 2
    local defs = {
        {key="drop",       label="DROP\nBR",      toggle=false},
        {key="autoLeft",   label="AUTO\nLEFT",    toggle=true},
        {key="autoRight",  label="AUTO\nRIGHT",   toggle=true},
        {key="autoBat",    label="AUTO\nBAT",     toggle=true},
        {key="tpBat",      label="TP\nBAT",       toggle=true},
        {key="tpDown",     label="TP\nDOWN",      toggle=false},
        {key="carry",      label="CARRY\nMODE",   toggle=true},
        {key="lagger",     label="LAGGER",        toggle=true},
    }
    local rows = math.ceil(#defs / COLS)
    local panelW = COLS * BTN_W + (COLS - 1) * GAP + 16
    local panelH = rows * BTN_H + (rows - 1) * GAP + 16

    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    sg.Name = "AKAI_StormButtons"
    sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
    sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    sg.DisplayOrder = 50
    pcall(function()
        if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(sg) end
    end)
    if not pcall(function() sg.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end) then
        sg.Parent = PGui
    end
    if _AK._extraGuis then table.insert(_AK._extraGuis, sg) end

    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Name = "StormBtnPanel"
    panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, panelW, 0, panelH)
    panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, math.max(8, vp.X - panelW - 18), 0.5, -panelH / 2)
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    panel.Parent = sg

    _AK._fbBtns = _AK._fbBtns or {}
    local _defaultFbPositions = {}
    local setOns = {}

    local OFF_BG = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 24)
    local ON_BG = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
    local OFF_BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50)
    local ON_BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 210)
    local TEXT_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
    local TEXT_ON = Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 18)

    local function makeBtn(def, idx)
        local col = (idx - 1) % COLS
        local row = math.floor((idx - 1) / COLS)
        local x = 8 + col * (BTN_W + GAP)
        local y = 8 + row * (BTN_H + GAP)

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = def.key
        _defaultFbPositions[def.key] = {xScale = 0, xOff = x, yScale = 0, yOff = y}
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_W, 0, BTN_H)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = OFF_BG
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        frame.ZIndex = 100
        frame.Parent = panel
        addCorner(frame, 10)
        local stroke = addStroke(frame, OFF_BORDER, 1.5)
        stroke.ZIndex = 101

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text = def.label
        btn.TextColor3 = TEXT_OFF
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        btn.TextSize = 11
        btn.TextWrapped = true
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 105
        btn.Parent = frame

        local isOn = false
        local function setOn(v)
            isOn = v and true or false
            frame:SetAttribute("BtnIsOn", isOn)
            if isOn then
                tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = ON_BG}, 0.12)
                tween(stroke, {Color = ON_BORDER}, 0.12)
                tween(btn, {TextColor3 = TEXT_ON}, 0.12)
            else
                tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = OFF_BG}, 0.12)
                tween(stroke, {Color = OFF_BORDER}, 0.12)
                tween(btn, {TextColor3 = TEXT_OFF}, 0.12)
            end
        end
        setOns[def.key] = setOn
        _AK._fbBtns[def.key] = frame

        local function flash()
            tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)}, 0.06)
            task.delay(0.15, function()
                if not isOn then tween(frame, {BackgroundColor3 = OFF_BG}, 0.1) end
            end)
        end

        local down, startPos, startFrame, dragging, justDragged = false, nil, nil, false, false
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if DragLocked then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            down = true; startPos = input.Position; startFrame = frame.Position; dragging = false; justDragged = false
        end)
        btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not down then return end
            if DragLocked then down = false; dragging = false; return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local d = input.Position - startPos
            if not dragging then
                if math.abs(d.X) > 8 or math.abs(d.Y) > 8 then dragging = true else return end
            end
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, startFrame.X.Offset + d.X, 0, startFrame.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            justDragged = true
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not down then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            down = false
            if dragging then task.delay(0.08, function() justDragged = false end) end
            dragging = false
        end)

        btn.Activated:Connect(function()
            if justDragged then return end
            if def.key == "drop" then
                pcall(runDrop); flash()
            elseif def.key == "tpDown" then
                pcall(runTPFloor); flash()
            elseif def.key == "autoLeft" then
                autoLeftEnabled = not autoLeftEnabled
                if autoLeftEnabled then
                    if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled = false; stopAutoRight(); if setOns.autoRight then setOns.autoRight(false) end end
                    if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat(); if setOns.autoBat then setOns.autoBat(false) end end
                    startAutoLeft(); setOn(true)
                else
                    stopAutoLeft(); setOn(false)
                end
            elseif def.key == "autoRight" then
                autoRightEnabled = not autoRightEnabled
                if autoRightEnabled then
                    if autoLeftEnabled then autoLeftEnabled = false; stopAutoLeft(); if setOns.autoLeft then setOns.autoLeft(false) end end
                    if autoBatEnabled then disableAutoBat(); if setOns.autoBat then setOns.autoBat(false) end end
                    startAutoRight(); setOn(true)
                else
                    stopAutoRight(); setOn(false)
                end
            elseif def.key == "autoBat" then
                if not autoBatEnabled then
                    if autoLeftEnabled then autoLeftEnabled = false; stopAutoLeft(); if setOns.autoLeft then setOns.autoLeft(false) end end
                    if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled = false; stopAutoRight(); if setOns.autoRight then setOns.autoRight(false) end end
                    enableAutoBat(); setOn(true)
                else
                    disableAutoBat(); setOn(false)
                end
            elseif def.key == "tpBat" then
                tpBatEnabled = not tpBatEnabled
                if tpBatEnabled then startTpBat() else stopTpBat() end
                setOn(tpBatEnabled)
            elseif def.key == "carry" then
                if not laggerToggled then
                    speedMode = not speedMode
                    setOn(speedMode)
                end
            elseif def.key == "lagger" then
                if not laggerToggled then
                    _prevSpeedMode = speedMode
                    laggerToggled = true
                    laggerPhase = speedMode and 2 or 0
                    speedMode = false
                    setOn(true)
                    if setOns.carry then setOns.carry(false) end
                else
                    laggerToggled = false
                    laggerPhase = 0
                    speedMode = _prevSpeedMode
                    setOn(false)
                    if setOns.carry then setOns.carry(speedMode) end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    for i, def in ipairs(defs) do makeBtn(def, i) end

    -- Reset only the floating button positions to the coordinates used at spawn.
    _AK._resetAllBtnPositions = function()
        for key, pos in pairs(_defaultFbPositions) do
            local frame = _AK._fbBtns[key]
            if frame and frame.Parent then
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(pos.xScale, pos.xOff, pos.yScale, pos.yOff)
            end
        end
    end

    _AK._setABOn = function(v) if setOns.autoBat then setOns.autoBat(v) end end
    _AK._setALOn = function(v) if setOns.autoLeft then setOns.autoLeft(v) end end
    _AK._setAROn = function(v) if setOns.autoRight then setOns.autoRight(v) end end

    if setOns.autoBat then setOns.autoBat(autoBatEnabled) end
    if setOns.autoLeft then setOns.autoLeft(autoLeftEnabled) end
    if setOns.autoRight then setOns.autoRight(autoRightEnabled) end
    if setOns.tpBat then setOns.tpBat(tpBatEnabled) end
    if setOns.carry then setOns.carry(speedMode and not laggerToggled) end
    if setOns.lagger then setOns.lagger(laggerToggled) end
end)()
