--  PLAYER PROFILE LIST (MAIN SCRIPT UI)
-- ==================================================================
;(function()
    local p = tabPages["MAIN"]
    sectionLabel(p, "PLAYERS", 60)

    local list = Instance.new("Frame")
    list.Name = "PlayerProfileList"
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    list.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.LayoutOrder = 61
    list.Parent = p

    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    layout.Parent = list

    local cards = {}

    local function clearCards()
        for _, card in pairs(cards) do
            if card and card.Parent then card:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(cards)
    end

    local function makeCard(player, order)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = ROW_ALPHA
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.LayoutOrder = order
        card.Parent = list
        addCorner(card, 10)
        addStroke(card, Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55), 1)

        local avatar = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        avatar.Name = "HeadProfile"
        avatar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)
        avatar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -19)
        avatar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
        avatar.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        avatar.BorderSizePixel = 0
        avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150"
        avatar.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        avatar.Parent = card
        addCorner(avatar, 19)
        addStroke(avatar, Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180), 1)

        local display = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        display.Name = "DisplayName"
        display.Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 19)
        display.Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 6)
        display.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        display.Text = player.DisplayName
        display.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        display.TextSize = 12
        display.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        display.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        display.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        display.Parent = card

        local username = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        username.Name = "Username"
        username.Size = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 17)
        username.Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 25)
        username.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        username.Text = "@" .. player.Name
        username.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190)
        username.TextSize = 10
        username.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        username.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        username.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        username.Parent = card

        return card
    end

    local function refreshPlayers()
        clearCards()
        local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
        table.sort(allPlayers, function(a, b) return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower() end)
        for order, player in ipairs(allPlayers) do
            cards[player.UserId] = makeCard(player, order)
        end
    end

    refreshPlayers()
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshPlayers)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(refreshPlayers)
end)()

-- ==================================================================
--  KEYBINDS
-- ==================================================================
;(function()
    local p = tabPages["MAIN"]

    -- --- KEYBINDS -------------------------------------------------
    sectionLabel(p, "KEYBINDS", 70)

    local _keybinds = {}      -- [key] = Enum.KeyCode value
    local _listeningFor = nil -- key string of the row currently listening
    -- Setters indexed by key so we can cancel a listener programmatically
    local _kbSetListening = {}
    
    -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    -- LOAD SAVED KEYBINDS FROM CONFIG
    -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function loadKeybindsFromConfig()
        local keybindConfigs = {
            "speedKey", "laggerKey", "autoLeft", "autoRight", "drop", 
            "tpDown", "autoBat", "tpBat",  "uiToggle"
        }
        
        for _, configKey in ipairs(keybindConfigs) do
            local savedValue = _configState["kb_" .. configKey]
            if savedValue then
                if type(savedValue) == "number" then
                    -- Convert numeric value back to Enum.KeyCode
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, kc in pairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
                            if kc.Value == savedValue then
                                _keybinds[configKey] = kc
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                elseif type(savedValue) == "string" then
                    -- Fallback: if saved as string, try to get it
                    pcall(function()
                        local kc = Enum.KeyCode[savedValue]
                        if kc then _keybinds[configKey] = kc end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    loadKeybindsFromConfig()
    -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    -- Expose clear function for Reset Config
    _AK._clearKeybinds = function()
        for k in pairs(_keybinds) do _keybinds[k] = nil end
        if _listeningFor then
            if _kbSetListening[_listeningFor] then _kbSetListening[_listeningFor](false) end
            _listeningFor = nil
        end
        for _, setL in pairs(_kbSetListening) do setL(false) end
    end

    local function _makeKBRow(parent, label, configKey, order)
        -- Stacked style: feature name top-left, big key badge below
        local Row = Instance.new("Frame")
        Row.Size               = UDim2.new(1,0,0,68)
        Row.BackgroundColor3   = Color3.fromRGB(18,18,18)
        Row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        Row.BorderSizePixel    = 0
        Row.LayoutOrder        = order
        Row.Parent             = parent
        addCorner(Row, 10)
        addStroke(Row, Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50), 1)

        -- Feature label (top-left)
        local rowLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", Row)
        rowLbl.Size               = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,18)
        rowLbl.Position           = UDim2.new(0,12,0,8)
        rowLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rowLbl.Text               = label
        rowLbl.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
        rowLbl.TextSize           = 12
        rowLbl.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        rowLbl.TextXAlignment     = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        rowLbl.ZIndex             = 5

        -- Key badge (below label, left-aligned like image)
        local badge = Instance.new("TextButton", Row)
        badge.Size               = UDim2.new(0,40,0,34)
        badge.Position           = UDim2.new(0,12,0,28)
        badge.BackgroundColor3   = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)
        badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        badge.BorderSizePixel    = 0
        badge.Text               = "?"
        badge.TextColor3         = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        badge.TextSize           = 14
        badge.Font               = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        badge.ZIndex             = 6
        addCorner(badge, 8)
        addStroke(badge, Color3.fromRGB(70,70,70), 1.5)

        local function refreshBadge()
            local kc = _keybinds[configKey]
            if kc then
                local name = tostring(kc):gsub("Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
                -- Shorten keyboard key names
                name = name:gsub("LeftShift","Shift"):gsub("RightShift","RShift")
                      :gsub("LeftControl","Ctrl"):gsub("RightControl","RCtrl")
                      :gsub("LeftAlt","Alt"):gsub("Return","Enter")
                -- Shorten gamepad button names
                name = name:gsub("ButtonA","  "):gsub("ButtonB","  ")
                      :gsub("ButtonX","  "):gsub("ButtonY","  ")
                      :gsub("DPadUp","D "):gsub("DPadDown","D ")
                      :gsub("DPadLeft","D "):gsub("DPadRight","D ")
                      :gsub("ButtonL1","LB"):gsub("ButtonR1","RB")
                      :gsub("ButtonL2","LT"):gsub("ButtonR2","RT")
                      :gsub("ButtonSelect","SEL"):gsub("ButtonStart","STR")
                      :gsub("ButtonL3","LS"):gsub("ButtonR3","RS")
                badge.Text       = name
                badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                badge.TextSize   = #name <= 2 and 14 or (#name <= 5 and 11 or 9)
                tween(badge, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)})
            else
                badge.Text       = "?"
                badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120)
                badge.TextSize   = 14
                tween(badge, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)})
            end
        end

        local function setListening(on)
            if on then
                badge.Text      = "..."
                badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
                badge.TextSize  = 11
                tween(badge, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,45,0)})
            else
                refreshBadge()
            end
        end

        _kbSetListening[configKey] = setListening

        badge.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if _listeningFor == configKey then
                _listeningFor = nil
                setListening(false)
                return
            end
            if _listeningFor then
                local prev = _listeningFor
                _listeningFor = nil
                if _kbSetListening[prev] then _kbSetListening[prev](false) end
            end
            _listeningFor = configKey
            setListening(true)
        end)

        hoverRow(Row, 0.25)
        refreshBadge()  -- Display loaded keybind immediately
        return Row
    end

    -- Capture key presses for both SETTING and FIRING keybinds
    rawConn(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, gpe)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        local kc = input.KeyCode
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end

        -- SETTING mode: a row is listening
        if _listeningFor then
            if gpe then return end
            _keybinds[_listeningFor] = kc
            _configState["kb_".._listeningFor] = kc.Value
            _autoSaveConfig()
            if _kbSetListening[_listeningFor] then _kbSetListening[_listeningFor](false) end
            _listeningFor = nil
            return
        end

        -- FIRING mode: check if this key matches any keybind
        if gpe then return end
        for configKey, boundKC in pairs(_keybinds) do
            if kc == boundKC then
                if configKey == "autoLeft" then
                    autoLeftEnabled = not autoLeftEnabled
                    if autoLeftEnabled then
                        if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled=false;stopAutoRight() end
                        startAutoLeft()
                    else stopAutoLeft() end
                elseif configKey == "autoRight" then
                    autoRightEnabled = not autoRightEnabled
                    if autoRightEnabled then
                        if autoLeftEnabled then autoLeftEnabled=false;stopAutoLeft() end
                        startAutoRight()
                    else stopAutoRight() end
                elseif configKey == "drop" then
                    runDrop()
                elseif configKey == "tpDown" then
                    runTPFloor()
                elseif configKey == "autoBat" then
                    if not autoBatEnabled then
                        if autoLeftEnabled  then autoLeftEnabled=false;stopAutoLeft() end
                        if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled=false;stopAutoRight() end
                        enableAutoBat()
                    else disableAutoBat() end
                elseif configKey == "tpBat" then
                    tpBatEnabled = not tpBatEnabled
                    if tpBatEnabled then startTpBat() else stopTpBat() end
                elseif configKey == "speedKey" then
                    if not laggerToggled then 
                        speedMode = not speedMode
                    elseif laggerPhase == 2 then  -- Lagger Carry → Speed Carry
                        laggerToggled = false
                        laggerPhase = 0
                        speedMode = true  -- activate speed carry (CS = 30)
                    elseif laggerPhase == 0 then  -- Lagger Normal → Speed Normal
                        laggerToggled = false
                        laggerPhase = 0
                        speedMode = false  -- activate speed normal (NS = 60)
                    end
                elseif configKey == "laggerKey" then
                    if not laggerToggled then
                        -- ═══ ENTER LAGGER MODE ═══
                        _prevSpeedMode = speedMode
                        laggerToggled = true
                        if speedMode then
                            laggerPhase = 2  -- was carrying: enter lagger carry
                        else
                            laggerPhase = 0  -- not carrying: enter lagger normal
                        end
                        speedMode = false
                    elseif laggerPhase == 0 then
                        -- ═══ LAGGER NORMAL → LAGGER CARRY ═══
                        laggerPhase = 2
                    elseif laggerPhase == 2 then
                        -- ═══ LAGGER CARRY → LAGGER NORMAL ═══
                        laggerPhase = 0
                    end
                elseif configKey == "uiToggle" then
                    Container.Visible = not Container.Visible
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Controller (gamepad) keybind support
    rawConn(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, gpe)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2 then return end
        local kc = input.KeyCode
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
        if _listeningFor then if gpe then return end
            _keybinds[_listeningFor] = kc
            _configState["kb_".._listeningFor] = kc.Value
            _autoSaveConfig()
            if _kbSetListening[_listeningFor] then _kbSetListening[_listeningFor](false) end
            _listeningFor = nil
            return
        end
        if gpe then return end
        for configKey, boundKC in pairs(_keybinds) do
            if kc == boundKC then
                if configKey == "autoLeft" then autoLeftEnabled = not autoLeftEnabled; if autoLeftEnabled then if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled=false;stopAutoRight() end; startAutoLeft() else stopAutoLeft() end
                elseif configKey == "autoRight" then autoRightEnabled = not autoRightEnabled; if autoRightEnabled then if autoLeftEnabled then autoLeftEnabled=false;stopAutoLeft() end; startAutoRight() else stopAutoRight() end
                elseif configKey == "drop" then runDrop()
                elseif configKey == "tpDown" then runTPFloor()
                elseif configKey == "autoBat" then if not autoBatEnabled then if autoLeftEnabled then autoLeftEnabled=false;stopAutoLeft() end; if autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled=false;stopAutoRight() end; enableAutoBat() else disableAutoBat() end
                elseif configKey == "tpBat" then tpBatEnabled = not tpBatEnabled; if tpBatEnabled then startTpBat() else stopTpBat() end
                elseif configKey == "speedKey" then 
                    if not laggerToggled then 
                        speedMode = not speedMode
                    elseif laggerPhase == 2 then  -- Lagger Carry → Speed Carry
                        laggerToggled = false
                        laggerPhase = 0
                        speedMode = true  -- activate speed carry (CS = 30)
                    elseif laggerPhase == 0 then  -- Lagger Normal → Speed Normal
                        laggerToggled = false
                        laggerPhase = 0
                        speedMode = false  -- activate speed normal (NS = 60)
                    end
                elseif configKey == "laggerKey" then
                    if not laggerToggled then
                        _prevSpeedMode=speedMode; laggerToggled=true
                        if speedMode then laggerPhase=2
                        else laggerPhase=0 end
                        speedMode=false
                    elseif laggerPhase==0 then
                        laggerPhase=2
                        if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.ls(LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) end
                    elseif laggerPhase==2 then
                        laggerPhase=0
                        if _AK._speedSetters then _AK._speedSetters.ls(LAGGER_SPEED) end
                    end
                elseif configKey == "uiToggle" then Container.Visible = not Container.Visible
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Speed/Lagger keybind rows placed INSIDE the SPEED section via LayoutOrder 3 and 6
    _makeKBRow(p, "SPEED KEYBIND",  "speedKey",  3)
    _makeKBRow(p, "LAGGER KEYBIND", "laggerKey", 6)

    local _kbItems = {
        {label="Auto Left",    key="autoLeft"},
        {label="Auto Right",   key="autoRight"},
        {label="Drop",         key="drop"},
        {label="TP Down",      key="tpDown"},
        {label="Auto Bat",     key="autoBat"},
        {label="TP Bat",       key="tpBat"},
                {label="UI TOGGLE",    key="uiToggle"},
    }

    for i, entry in ipairs(_kbItems) do
        _makeKBRow(p, entry.label, entry.key, 71 + i)
    end

end)()


-- ==================================================================
--  AKAI PING NOTIFIER  (spike toast — HUD ping embedded in steal bar)
-- ==================================================================
;(function()
    -- Ping label and dot are embedded in the steal bar (AKAIDuels_HUD)
    local _pingLbl  = _AK._pingLblInBar
    local _dotInner = _AK._pingDotInner

    -- -- Spike toast ----------------------------------------------
    local _toastSG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    _toastSG.Name           = "AKAI_PingToast"
    _toastSG.ResetOnSpawn   = false
    _toastSG.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    _toastSG.DisplayOrder   = 225
    pcall(function() if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(_toastSG) end end)
    if not pcall(function()
        local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        _toastSG.Parent = cg
    end) then _toastSG.Parent = PGui end

    local _toast = Instance.new("Frame", _toastSG)
    _toast.AnchorPoint          = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    _toast.Position             = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 52)
    _toast.Size                 = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 44)
    _toast.BackgroundColor3     = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
    _toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    _toast.BorderSizePixel      = 0
    _toast.Visible              = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", _toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local _toastStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", _toast)
    _toastStroke.Color       = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    _toastStroke.Thickness   = 1.5
    _toastStroke.Transparency = 1

    local _toastTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", _toast)
    _toastTitle.Size                = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 18)
    _toastTitle.Position            = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
    _toastTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    _toastTitle.Text                = "! PING SPIKE"
    _toastTitle.TextColor3          = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    _toastTitle.TextTransparency    = 1
    _toastTitle.Font                = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    _toastTitle.TextSize            = 12
    _toastTitle.TextXAlignment      = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local _toastSub = Instance.new("TextLabel", _toast)
    _toastSub.Size                  = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14)
    _toastSub.Position              = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 24)
    _toastSub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    _toastSub.Text                  = ""
    _toastSub.TextColor3            = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
    _toastSub.TextTransparency      = 1
    _toastSub.Font                  = Enum.Font.Gotham
    _toastSub.TextSize              = 10
    _toastSub.TextXAlignment        = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local _toastShowing = false
    local function _showSpike(ms)
        if _toastShowing then return end
        _toastShowing = true
        _toastSub.Text  = tostring(ms) .. "ms - high ping detected"
        _toast.Visible  = true
        local _ti = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        TS:Create(_toast,      _ti, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08}):Play()
        TS:Create(_toastStroke,_ti, {Transparency = 0.3}):Play()
        TS:Create(_toastTitle, _ti, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
        TS:Create(_toastSub,   _ti, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
        -- Blink dot red briefly
        if _dotInner then TS:Create(_dotInner, _ti, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)}):Play() end
        task.delay(2.5, function()
            local _to = TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
            TS:Create(_toast,      _to, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            TS:Create(_toastStroke,_to, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            TS:Create(_toastTitle, _to, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
            TS:Create(_toastSub,   _to, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
            if _dotInner then TS:Create(_dotInner, _to, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play() end
            task.delay(0.45, function()
                _toast.Visible  = false
                _toastShowing   = false
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- -- Live ping update loop (every 0.8 s) ----------------------
    local _lastPing = 0
    local _acc, _elapsed = 0, 0
    rawConn(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        _acc     = _acc + dt
        _elapsed = _elapsed + dt
        if _elapsed < 0.8 then return end
        _elapsed = 0
        local _pm = 0
        pcall(function()
            _pm = math.floor(
                game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
            )
        end)
        -- Colour-code: white < 80, yellow 80-149, red 150+
        local col
        if _pm < 80 then
            col = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
        elseif _pm < 150 then
            col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
        else
            col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
        end
        if _pingLbl then
            _pingLbl.Text       = "MS: " .. _pm
            _pingLbl.TextColor3 = col
        end
        -- Spike: jumped 100+ms and above 100 total
        if _lastPing > 0 and (_pm - _lastPing) >= 100 and _pm > 100 then
            _showSpike(_pm)
        end
        _lastPing = _pm
    end)

    -- FPS counter (smoothed over 0.8 s windows)
    local _fpsLabel = _AK._fpsLbl
    local _fpsAcc, _fpsFrames = 0, 0
    rawConn(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        _fpsAcc    = _fpsAcc + dt
        _fpsFrames = _fpsFrames + 1
        if _fpsAcc >= 0.8 then
            local fps = math.floor(_fpsFrames / _fpsAcc)
            if _fpsLabel and _fpsLabel.Parent then
                _fpsLabel.Text = "FPS: " .. fps
            end
            _fpsAcc, _fpsFrames = 0, 0
        end
    end)
end)()
